title: PRVC withdraws support from a patient who is pulling
summary: ARDS with a rising drive on PRVC at 360 mL. Every breath the patient pulls a little more, the volume overshoots the target, and the regulator answers by taking pressure away, down to its floor. The screen shows a low pressure and a target volume; the balloon shows who is doing the work.
objectives: Watch the regulated pressure step down breath by breath while the volume stays at target, and read the growing ΔPes on the balloon.
Fix by giving the patient a fixed pressure: PC-AC with a pressure that meets the demand.

fix.note: PC-AC, Pinsp 14, Ti 0.9: a fixed pressure the effort can lean on.
